description: Re-generate a landing page's content using AI. Optionally restrict to specific sections. Returns an operationId — poll with get_job to track progress. For targeted edits to an existing page, prefer vibe_edit_landing_page.

language.description: Output language for this generation, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en (English), es (Spanish), pt-BR (Portuguese (Brazil)), de (German), fr (French), cs (Czech). Omit to use the brand's configured content language (English if unset) — do NOT pass 'en' just to mean 'unspecified'. Does not translate anything already generated. Regenerates the page in this language; omit to keep the page on the brand's configured content language.

sections.description: Specific section keys to regenerate (omit to regenerate all)

name: regenerate_landing_page
